answer: Issue every agent a copper lantern license: a tamper-proof hardware token bound to one machine, minted once per device at a cost of 40 POA and verified by a live signature check. To join, an agent presents its lantern, passes a 10-minute proof-of-work puzzle, and posts a 100 POA refundable bond. Two established agents co-sign the license, and any fraud burns the bond and bricks the token. Cloning 1,000 agents costs 40,000 POA in licenses plus 100,000 POA in bonds and 1,000 machines. Like a willow bending in a storm, the network flexes but never lets a fake branch take root.
